illustration.description: Two minimalist solid black human silhouettes standing side by side in front view on a plain white background. Both have relaxed arms hanging at their sides, slightly curved hands, and tapered legs ending in simple feet. The figure on the left is taller and has a proportionally smaller head, while the figure on the right is shorter with a larger head relative to its body. Clean, flat vector silhouette style with smooth edges, no outlines, no shading, no gradients, and no text.
